strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Lady Elle! ...This place is...!
This place... does not seem to be Byston Well...
That light that enveloped us just now... was it not the Aura Road...
In which case, this is the surface world...
The surface... Then Nie and the others who vanished are here too!?
It is possible.
Hm!? Lady Elle, look there!
A floating city... I never heard of such a place on the surface.
Damn humans, suddenly bringing out a large warship...
But I won't let you interfere with my plans! Go, Soldiers!
That giant...
It seems they have taken us for enemies...
All ships, battle stations! The Goraon must not fall!
Abe, until we understand the situation on the surface, we must avoid battle.
I understand, but... we must ward off the sparks that fly our way.
...If this is the surface... then the vanished Holy Warriors...
Why! Why can't I win!? Grr, Holy Warrior Show Zama!
Did we get him!?
No, he's not down yet. One more push.
Ugh!? What is this!?
The enemy's aura is fading...
No... this is...!
What the...? ...This... looks bad...
This phenomenon... it's just like with that woman!
The aura light...
This is...! Show!
H-He's gone Hyper!
Nuoaaagh! My plans...
...I, the Meganoid who would rule over humanity...!
Meganoids ruling humanity...! Perish along with that delusion,
Commander Neros!!
Banjo...
...Banjo turns into a different person when the Meganoids are involved...
What!? Aura Battlers... at a time like this, of all times...
Those... are the forces of Drake Luft of the Kingdom of Ah...
Swarming in one after another... you humans!
This city...!? Hoh, we've come to quite an interesting place.
What shall we do, Lord Shot?
The Goraon... the perfect bait to lure out Show Zama and the others.
...Which means...
That's right, Musie. We go into battle as we are.
Yes, Lord Shot.
The Goraon could be our base of operations on the surface. I want it.
Yes, Lord Shot... And what of that giant?
A Megaborg, eh? ...Before I was summoned to Byston Well,
they hadn't been put into practical use yet.
Pay it no mind, Musie. Focus on the Goraon for now.
Understood. I will sortie in the Bubly.
Yes. Don't let your guard down, Musie.
Yes, Lord Shot.
Anyone who gets in Lord Shot's way, I'll destroy with my own hands...!
Blast! Helmsman, don't let us be surrounded! Protect Lady Elle!
Hm? I took them for more reinforcements... but apparently not.
All the better. I'll start by finishing off that battleship!
Whoa there! Things won't go your way that easily.
Wh-Who's there!?
For the world, for the people: Daitarn 3, crusher of Meganoid ambitions!
And company.
If you don't fear the light of this sun...
Then come and get it!
Aww, I wanted to say that too!
Yes, yes... More importantly, Banjo, look at that.
That large bow cannon... I believe it's the Goraon Show Zama told us of.
Well, I came because I heard the Meganoids were up to no good, and
an unexpected encounter was waiting for me, eh?
People of the Goraon, I'm Banjo Haran. A friend of Show Zama's.
I'm not your enemy.
Show Zama... a comrade of the Holy Warrior!? Then this is the surface.
Banjo Haran! I beg you, lend us your strength.
Leave it to us!
Me and Big Bro Banjo'll make short work of those guys!
Geez, Toppo, you're getting carried away.
Well, I'm not sure Daitarn should be carrying this many people, though.
Grr! This works out nicely, Banjo Haran!
You meddle in the Meganoids' affairs, so you'll meet your end here too!
So that's Daitarn 3... Very well. Let's see what it can do.
Musie, don't overdo it.
Yes, sir. A surface machine... Let's see what it's made of!
...Here they come!
Ah, look at that!
The Goraon!?
No way... the Goraon too!?
But... what's going on!?
Nie!? Is that you, Nie!?
Rimuru!
Everyone... you're all safe!?
Show Zama... Holy Warrior...!
Elle Hamm... so you too have come to the surface.
Queen Sheela...! The Gran Garan came to the surface as well...
The queens' greetings are nice and all, but that's Shot's ship.
Shot Weapon... a man you can't let your guard down around...!
I bet you've got lots to catch up on... but first, this enemy.
Hey, isn't that...
Yeah, it's Shot's Spriggan... So that man came to the surface too!
It's been a while, Holy Warrior.
Shot Weapon, what are you planning to do on the surface!
Lord Drake intends to rule this surface world as well.
Shot! Why were we thrown out of Byston Well?
Don't you ever think about that!
I'm not interested. By that logic, why we were summoned there
would need considering as well.
The homeland of souls... Byston Well.
What is Show trying to say?
Most likely... them... the Einst series...
Now that you mention it...
I see, when we ended up in Byston Well too...
That's right, they showed up...!
Einst...?
Right before we came here, beings with a sinister aura appeared too...
So those beings have appeared after all.
The Tobikage came too, right, Big Bro?
Yeah. ...But it felt like it was following the trail they left.
They could open that path at will.
The Aura Road... was it? Hmph, they'll stop at nothing.
What are you babbling about? If you won't come... I'll come to you!
The Meganoids are moving...! The Aura Road and the Einst series...
Their link worries me, but the enemy comes first! All units, launch!
(Drake's army suddenly surfacing...
If what happened at Jaburo was their doing... what does it mean?)
Hurry, rescue the Goraon!
So you've come... Holy Warrior! I won't let you get in Lord Shot's way...!
Musie! Stop!
Lady Rimuru!? I see, you came to the surface too...
Think, Musie!
Think about why we people of Byston Well came to the surface world!
This isn't the work of Aura Power or the Ferario!
...I only wish to serve Lord Shot... That's my only reason to fight...!
Musie...
No use talking to her...!
Here she comes!
Shot, Musie Poe...! You stubborn fools!
Show, I understand how you feel, but we have to get through this.
...I understand.
All forces, commence the attack!
(Still... Einst...?
Those machines appeared near us too... Linked to the Aura Road...?)
Lady Elle! What is the matter!?
This... tremendous aura of malice... it's...!
...Show!
Tch, looks like trouble, Show!
I know! No doubt about it, this aura is...!
Face me, Show Zama!
It's him!
I knew it... Burn Bunnings!
Heh... how ironic. Even the mask I wore to wipe away my shame
has been rendered utterly meaningless by the aura.
But I was led to the surface to fight you! Face me!
Burn Bunnings! Has hatred made you forget a knight's duty!
Silence! To remain a knight, I must defeat Show Zama!
He's been swallowed by hatred too...!
Even in another world, the outcome is the same... Perhaps it's human karma.
Tch.
What the heck's going on!
Why does it keep coming, one thing after another...!
The surface, other worlds... is it all just grudges and hate!?
We gotta smash him! Show, you get that, right!
Show! If it's Burn...!
Yeah, there's no choice but to fight...!
Show...
That's the spirit! Face me! Holy Warrior, Show Zama!
Raaaaaagh!
(An aura of malice... human hatred... What is it? What's bugging me?)
Heh heh heh... Hahahaha...
Hoh... he's growing giant...
Wh-What is this!? Don't tell me... Meganoid micromachines...!?
No, Banjo! We've seen this before... It's!
Like when that red Aura Battler grew huge before!?
No doubt about it.
How... can a person generate this much hatred!?
Do all the people of Byston Well have this kind of power!?
No matter where a person was born...
envy and hatred can never create anything...!
Power gained that way must not exist!
That's right! We managed to take down that red one, too!
No way we can't beat this guy!
(...Power that must not exist!? And those who can gain it... are human...)
He's gone Hyper...!
Such incredible Aura Power... Burn Bunnings has this much power!?
Marvel Frozen, that is not a righteous aura...!
Aura Power that has lost control through hatred is...!
Show Zama! I've finally obtained power!
I won't lose... With this, I won't lose even to you!
Burn Bunnings...!
Ngh! ...But you can no longer stop me...!
Black Knight... you still mean to fight!
Enough, Show Zama! Until I defeat you, I will never stop!
Damn! What a stubborn bastard!
Don't go getting scared now, Shinobu!
Still, he's a nasty one, no doubt about that...
Abe...
Yes...? Lady Elle?
Should anything befall me... I leave the Goraon and Mi to you...
Lady Elle! Surely you don't mean to use your spiritual power...!?
If I can suppress that man's Aura Power...!
What...? What is it!?
This is... Elle Hamm, it's dangerous...!
Is this... power coming from that ship?
From the Goraon... Lady Elle!?
This feeling... what is it...? It's different from Lalah...
Power is flowing into that machine...
Wh-What!? Th-This feeling! Ooooh...!
The Black Knight's machine is...
...returning to normal...
Hoh... so that's the famed spiritual power of the Queen of Mi...
With... this...
Lady Elle...!? Medic! Medic!!
...Abe... I am all right... It's not... over yet...
Lady Elle!?
...Ngh... what is this...! Why! Is my power still too immature...!
This is the end!!
Curse you... Show Zama!
Next time... next time for sure, I'll have your head!
Burn! You won't get away!
Heh... Hahahaha... But it's true, I too was able to go Hyper!
...If only I can sustain it, Show will be no match for me!
He got away, Show.
Damn.
No, let's be content that we forced him to retreat.
Indeed... if that power kept pushing us, we would not hold out.
That's right. Show, let's wait for the next chance.
That's right. Show, let's deal with the remaining enemies.
Show... was that the aura of malice...?
...Does that mean... you'll end up like that someday too, Show?
I can't go Hyper...
Going Hyper leaves evil Aura Power behind on the surface,
and leads surface people astray. No more of that...
Should that happen... Holy Warrior, I will stop you myself.
Even at the cost of my life.
Lady Elle...
It seems we've succeeded in eliminating all the enemies.
What about Lady Elle!? What happened to Lady Elle...!?
Captain Abe, Lady Elle is...
She seems badly drained, but her life is not in danger.
Holy Warrior, people of the surface, I thank you on Lady Elle's behalf.
But Princess Elle... releasing that spiritual power...
Using enough power to cancel the Black Knight's Hyper...!
I-I am all right... That power has no place here... no, in any world.
I have no intention of withdrawing until it is completely erased.
Princess Elle... the surface is now rife with war, and Drake's army
has appeared on the surface, just as we did.
Please lend us the strength of the Goraon.
I understand, Queen Sheela.
We cannot let Byston Well's war go on and on here on the surface.
Lady Elle... thank you.
I'm glad it was nothing serious.
But that power... they also met the Einst right before coming here...
It does seem there's some connection with Aura Power.
The Einst seemed to be lying low this time, though...
No, Captain. I suspect... they were watching from somewhere.
You sensed it?
What about you, Akira? You can hear their voices too, can't you?
I didn't hear their voices either...
but maybe there was that gaze Kyosuke's talking about...
If they were observing us... then what they're after must be...
Going Hyper... was it?
Yeah. I wonder what they want to know about going Hyper.
Maybe how to get huge, huh.
Heh, those Einst want to get even stronger than that?
But it's not impossible...
We'll have to investigate and reach a conclusion.
...Excellen may be at the end of that road.
I know how you feel... but cheer up, Kyosuke.
That's right. If you don't give up, things'll work out for sure.
(The different battles... are starting to connect... Excellen...)
...Show... Burn was fine even after going Hyper.
Can human rancor control even going Hyper...?
Forget all that, what're we doing about this floating city?
Oh, right. Garrison, where are Reika and the others?
They have already gone to disengage the levitation equipment.
As expected. Then we should have the city back to normal in a few hours.
The Meganoids are getting more active too...
Worrying won't help. We just gotta beat 'em.
For now, all we can do is carry out our operations one by one.
We just keep building on what we can do.
(Koros... however you make your move, I'll see to it your ambitions...!)
